summary: Validated pipeline/ozonetel buckets, index-friendly search (phone vs name prefix), pagination, caller scoping, no-regression filters, and new Conversion Page capture via website webhook + LeadDetail Attribution UI. 22/22 pytest cases pass in ~7.6s over 120k+ leads. Frontend confirmed: Attribution card renders 'Conversion Page' with the URL from webhook.

issues: Console warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key' — non-blocking React key duplication on LeadDetail render

critical_code_review_comments: leads.py search branch: when the query has BOTH letters and >=4 digits (e.g. 'Lead 6500'), the $or also includes a phone_digits prefix, so results may be a phone match, not a name-prefix match. This is technically 'match any of name/contact/email/phone prefix' — acceptable, but the PRD wording 'name prefix' can mislead. Consider documenting behaviour or gating phone-branch only when the token is purely numeric.
webhooks.py FIELD_ALIASES correctly maps page_url/page_name/form_name -> conversion_page (verified with 3 parametrized posts).
Compound index {active,pipeline,create_date,id} makes pipeline/ozonetel buckets sub-second on 120k docs (measured ~0.1–0.3s).
